title: From Search to Research: Exploring Search Scaling in Autonomous Quantitative Factor Mining
title_zh: 从搜索到研究：探索自主量化因子挖掘中的搜索扩展

paragraphs.en: Inference scaling has been shown to improve large language model (LLM) performance, and this principle naturally extends to autonomous LLM agents through increased search budgets, which we refer to as search scaling . Although prior work has characterized the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and performance limits of LLM inference scaling, much less is known about these questions in autonomous research. Therefore, we investigate how search scaling affects research performance and what mechanisms drive these gains using 50 quantitative factor-mining tasks grounded in financial research reports. Each task requires an agent to carry out an end-to-end research loop, from interpreting a hypothesis and implementing it in code to evaluating and iteratively refining the resulting factor. Across nine models, we examine how model capability, search depth, and search organization shape factor quality by tracing performance across varying budgets, transferring intermediate research states between models, and comparing different search strategies. We find that (1) initial performance is more strongly associated with model capability, while deeper search can narrow cross-model gaps; (2) model grafting shows that the early research state materially shapes final performance; and (3) parallel search outperforms sequential search under the same iteration budget, consistent with benefits from broader coverage of the search space. Further trajectory analysis shows that higher-performing models more effectively diagnose failures, revise search directions, and preserve the intended economic hypothesis when selecting candidates. These findings suggest that future progress in autonomous research will require stronger models together with adaptive policies for deploying test-time computation throughout the research process.
paragraphs.zh: 已有研究表明，推理扩展能够提升大型语言模型（LLM）的性能，这一原则自然也适用于自主 LLM 智能体——通过增加搜索预算来实现，我们将其称为“搜索扩展”。 尽管先前的研究已经描述了 LLM 推理扩展的机制、扩展行为及性能极限，但在自主研究领域中，这些问题仍知之甚少。 因此，我们借助 50 个基于金融研究报告的定量因子挖掘任务，探究了搜索扩展如何影响研究性能，以及哪些机制推动了这些性能提升。 每个任务都要求智能体完成一个端到端的研究循环：从解读假设并用代码实现，到评估并迭代优化最终得到的因子。 我们针对九种模型进行了研究，通过追踪不同预算下的性能表现、在模型间转移中间研究状态以及比较不同的搜索策略，分析了模型能力、搜索深度和搜索组织方式如何影响因子的质量。 我们的发现表明：（1）初始性能与模型能力的关联更强，而更深入的搜索可以缩小不同模型之间的差距；（2）模型嫁接实验显示，早期的研究状态会对最终性能产生实质性影响；（3）在相同的迭代预算下，并行搜索的表现优于顺序搜索，这与扩大搜索空间覆盖范围所带来的优势一致。 进一步的轨迹分析显示，性能更高的模型在筛选候选因子时，能够更有效地诊断失败、调整搜索方向，并保留预期的经济假设。 这些发现表明，未来自主研究的进步需要更强力的模型，以及能够在整个研究过程中动态分配测试时计算资源的自适应策略。

paragraphs.en: Scaling parameters, data, and training compute has improved language-model capabilities ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ; Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) . Deployment-time scaling asks what additional computation can achieve once the model is fixed ( Snell et al., 2025 ) . When that computation is used to run dependent experiments, update an artifact, and carry empirical evidence into subsequent decisions, we call it search scaling . This setting extends scaling beyond generating more tokens or independent candidate answers: an agent must observe results, diagnose failures, and choose the next experiment ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Rank et al., 2026 ) . In this regime, added computation pays off only when the agent converts feedback into useful experiments, so the return to search may depend on the base model.
paragraphs.zh: 参数扩展、数据和训练计算能力的提升增强了语言模型的能力（Kaplan 等，2020；Hoffmann 等，2022）。 部署时的扩展关注的是模型固定后，额外的计算还能带来哪些成果（Snell 等，2025）。 当这些计算被用于运行依赖实验、更新某个成果，并将经验证据带入后续决策时，我们称之为搜索扩展。 这种设定将扩展的范围延伸至生成更多词元或独立候选答案之外：智能体必须观察结果、诊断失败并选择下一个实验（Yao 等，2023；Rank 等，2026）。 在这种机制下，额外的计算只有在智能体能将反馈转化为有效实验时才会产生回报，因此搜索的回报可能取决于基础模型。

paragraphs.en: Existing test-time scaling studies examine independent sampling, verification, answer aggregation, and sequential answer refinement, including when smaller models benefit from larger inference budgets ( Snell et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . Research-engineering benchmarks also compare agents under different time budgets ( Wijk et al., 2025 ) . These results leave open how capability and budget interact in dependent empirical search, where agents choose experiments, interpret their results, and use that evidence to decide the next action. More experiments provide opportunities for improvement but also for mistaken diagnoses, unproductive local search, and adaptive selection that favors noise. Greater search depth therefore need not improve search quality. Initial quality and the ability to improve through feedback may also differ: a strong initial proposal need not imply sustained gains, while a weaker starting point may leave room for effective revision. The key question is not simply whether more research helps, but how base-model capability shapes the marginal value of additional experimentation and the performance level that iterative search can reach.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的测试时扩展研究考察了独立采样、验证、答案聚合和顺序答案优化，包括较小模型在更大推理预算下的受益情况（Snell 等人，2025；Wu 等人，2025）。 研究工程基准也对比了不同时间预算下智能体的表现（Wijk 等人，2025）。 这些结果尚未阐明能力与预算在依赖性的经验搜索中如何相互作用：在此类搜索中，智能体需要选择实验、解释其结果，并利用这些证据来决定下一步行动。 更多实验虽然为改进提供了机会，但也可能导致错误诊断、低效的局部搜索，以及偏向噪声的自适应选择。 因此，更深的搜索深度并不必然能提升搜索质量。 初始质量以及通过反馈进行改进的能力也可能存在差异：一个强有力的初始提案未必意味着持续的提升，而一个较弱的起点则可能为有效修订留下空间。 关键问题并非简单地在于更多研究是否有帮助，而在于基础模型的能力如何影响额外实验的边际价值，以及迭代搜索所能达到的性能水平。

paragraphs.en: Quantitative factor construction provides a controlled yet non-trivial testbed for this question. Grounded in the search for signals that rank assets ( Zhang et al., 2020 ; Yu et al., 2023 ) , our tasks require agents to construct factors without training a predictive model. Additional iterations therefore change research behavior without also increasing model-training compute, optimizer steps, or training stochasticity. Economic hypotheses constrain the search space, and LLM-based idea-alignment checks ( Appendix C.3 ) discourage revisions that abandon the intended hypothesis to pursue backtest scores. These constraints limit unrestricted fitting, while repeated candidate selection on development backtests still creates multiple-testing risk. Noisy financial feedback, local optima, and adaptive selection preserve a substantive generalization problem, making held-out evaluation essential. With a fixed environment and shared harness, this setting lets us examine how agents use additional experimental opportunities to improve out-of-sample factor quality while preserving the intended economic hypothesis.
paragraphs.zh: 定量因子构建为此问题提供了一个受控但非平凡的测试环境。 基于对资产排序信号的研究（Zhang et al., 2020; Yu et al., 2023），我们的任务要求智能体在不训练预测模型的情况下构建因子。 因此，额外的迭代会改变研究行为，但不会增加模型训练的算力、优化器步数或训练随机性。 经济假设对搜索空间施加了限制，而基于大语言模型的观点对齐检查（附录 C.3）则抑制了那些为追求回测得分而放弃既定假设的修改方案。 这些限制约束了无限制的拟合过程，但同时在开发阶段对候选因子进行重复回测仍会产生多重检验风险。 噪声干扰的金融反馈、局部最优解以及自适应选择机制保留了实质性的泛化问题，因此保留样本评估至关重要。 在固定环境和共享框架下，这一设置使我们能够研究智能体如何利用额外的实验机会来提升样本外因子的质量，同时保持既定的经济假设不变。

paragraphs.en: To answer these questions, we build a benchmark of 50 tasks grounded in quantitative research reports from the Chinese A-share market. Each task supplies an economic hypothesis and a factor-construction idea, and an agent working through a shared general-purpose harness implements the factor, runs development-period backtests, and revises its candidate; with the execution architecture fixed, the base model and the search budget are the principal experimental variables. We evaluate nine models along continuous ten-iteration trajectories: the harness freezes a checkpoint after every iteration, an independent evaluator scores it on a held-out period, and we report results at iterations 3, 6, and 10 with realized resource consumption recorded separately from nominal depth. Treating base-model capability, nominal search depth, and realized resource consumption as distinct quantities ( Section 3.1 ), we further conduct two controlled interventions, model grafting and a sequential–parallel comparison, to probe what makes iterative search effective. Our contributions are:

paragraphs.en: We characterize cross-model budget-performance curves and fit an empirical search scaling law, finding that base capability tracks initial quality more closely than marginal search gains and that deeper search can narrow some cross-model gaps.

paragraphs.en: We analyze cost and compute allocation through model grafting and sequential–parallel interventions, showing that early research-state quality and search breadth can matter as much as additional depth.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过模型嫁接以及序列-并行干预方法，分析了成本与计算资源的分配问题，结果表明，早期研究状态的质量和搜索广度可能和增加深度一样重要。

paragraphs.en: We connect trajectory behavior to outcome differences, finding that higher-performing models redirect search at the representation level, attribute feedback through controlled comparisons, and retain candidates that remain consistent with the assigned economic hypothesis.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将轨迹行为与结果差异联系起来，发现性能更高的模型会在表示层面对搜索进行重新引导，通过受控比较来传递属性反馈，并保留那些与既定经济假设保持一致的候选项。

paragraphs.en: Scaling Laws and Test-Time Compute. Training scaling laws relate language-model loss to parameter count, data volume, and training compute, guiding the allocation of pretraining resources ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ; Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) . Incorporating inference demand extends this allocation problem to deployment and can favor smaller models trained on more data ( Sardana et al., 2024 ) . Test-time scaling then treats computation per problem as a decision variable. Verifier-guided search, sequential revision, and comparisons of sampling, voting, tree search, and diversified agent rollouts already establish that smaller models can outperform larger ones with sufficient inference computation under suitable conditions ( Snell et al., 2025 ; Setlur et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . General AgentBench extends sequential and parallel scaling to general agents and finds that added computation can be constrained by a context ceiling and a verification gap ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Model–compute substitution is therefore a starting point for studying research agents.
paragraphs.zh: 扩展定律与测试时计算资源。 训练扩展定律将语言模型损失与参数数量、数据量及训练计算资源相关联，从而指导预训练资源的分配（Kaplan 等，2020；Hoffmann 等，2022）。 纳入推理需求后，这一分配问题会延伸至部署阶段，并可能使在更多数据上训练的较小模型更具优势（Sardana 等，2024）。 测试时扩展则将每个问题的计算量视为一个决策变量。 验证器引导搜索、序列式修正，以及对采样、投票、树搜索和多样化智能体展开的对比研究均已表明，在适当条件下，只要具备足够的推理计算资源，较小模型的表现可能优于较大模型（Snell 等，2025；Setlur 等，2025；Wu 等，2025；Zhu 等，2025）。 通用 AgentBench 将序列式和并行扩展推广至通用智能体，并发现额外计算资源可能受到上下文上限和验证差距的限制（Li 等，2026）。 因此，模型与计算资源的替代关系是研究智能体的一个起点。

paragraphs.en: Connecting these results to autonomous research requires distinguishing compute allocation from feedback generation. Independent sampling explores alternative candidates, whereas sequential revision conditions later proposals on previous attempts. In the reasoning settings above, answer aggregation and learned outcome or process verification guide selection. Tool-using research agents additionally generate evidence by implementing hypotheses and executing experiments ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Rank et al., 2026 ) . Although a research evaluator also serves a verification role, agents must decide which experiment to run and how its results should change the artifact. Research-time scaling thus depends on converting experimental feedback into useful revisions; in factor research, their value must also be assessed beyond the historical data that guided development.
paragraphs.zh: 要将这些结果与自主研究联系起来，需要区分计算资源分配与反馈生成。 独立采样会探索替代候选方案，而序列修订则会根据先前的尝试来约束后续提案。 在上述推理场景中，答案聚合以及对结果或过程的验证指导了选择过程。 使用工具的科研智能体还会通过实施假设和开展实验来生成证据（Yao et al., 2023 ; Rank et al., 2026）。 尽管研究评估者也承担验证角色，但智能体必须决定执行哪项实验，以及其结果应如何改变成果物。 因此，研究阶段的扩展取决于将实验反馈转化为有效的修订；在因子研究中，还必须评估这些反馈的价值是否超越了指导开发的原始数据。

paragraphs.en: Autonomous Research and Experimentation. Autonomous research spans full-cycle systems and evaluation environments. The AI Scientist links idea generation, implementation, experiments, and manuscript production, while MLE-bench evaluates competition-style machine-learning engineering and PaperBench tests research replication ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Chan et al., 2025 ; Starace et al., 2025 ) . Performance-driven benchmarks leave the solution open: RE-Bench provides research-engineering objectives with task-specific evaluation, ResearchGym supplies datasets, baselines, and evaluation code for discovering improved methods, and PostTrainBench optimizes a post-training pipeline evaluated on held-out benchmarks ( Wijk et al., 2025 ; Garikaparthi et al., 2026 ; Rank et al., 2026 ) . Across these settings, evaluation measures what an agent system accomplishes through sustained experimental work.
paragraphs.zh: 自主研究与实验。 自主研究涵盖全周期系统和评估环境。 AI科学家将创意生成、实施、实验和论文撰写连接起来，而MLE-bench则评估竞赛风格的机器学习工程，PaperBench则测试研究的可重复性（Lu et al., 2024；Chan et al., 2025；Starace et al., 2025）。 以性能为导向的基准测试允许解决方案存在多样性：RE-Bench为研究工程目标提供任务特定的评估，ResearchGym提供数据集、基线模型和评估代码以发现更优方法，而PostTrainBench则优化在预留基准测试集上评估的后训练流程（Wijk et al., 2025；Garikaparthi et al., 2026；Rank et al., 2026）。 在这些不同设置中，评估衡量的是智能体系统通过持续实验工作所完成的任务。

paragraphs.en: Budget allocation determines how that work can accumulate. RE-Bench varies both attempt duration and the number of independent attempts, combining longer trajectories with best-of- k k selection. ResearchGym examines continuation by allocating additional resources to selected runs, and PostTrainBench reports time-budget curves, resource use, and scaffold comparisons ( Wijk et al., 2025 ; Garikaparthi et al., 2026 ; Rank et al., 2026 ) . Independent restarts explore alternative initial plans; continuation lets decisions build on accumulated code and empirical evidence. We study the latter mechanism by varying research depth within a single trajectory and examining how its returns depend on the base model.
paragraphs.zh: 预算分配决定了这些工作如何逐步积累。 RE-Bench 会同时调整尝试的持续时间和独立尝试的数量，将更长的轨迹与“k 选最佳”策略相结合。 ResearchGym 通过为选定的运行分配额外资源来研究延续机制，而 PostTrainBench 则报告时间预算曲线、资源使用情况以及脚手架对比（Wijk 等，2025；Garikaparthi 等，2026；Rank 等，2026）。 独立的重新开始会探索不同的初始计划；而延续机制则允许决策基于已积累的代码和实证证据进行构建。 我们通过在一个单一轨迹内调整研究深度，并考察其收益如何依赖于基础模型，来研究后一种机制。

paragraphs.en: Trading Agents and Quantitative Factor Research. Financial-agent evaluation connects decisions to their consequences in an evolving environment. Sequential investment evaluation in InvestorBench and StockBench has expanded toward live-market evaluation in DeepFund, LiveTradeBench, and AI-Trader ( Li et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Fan et al., 2025 ) . Capability attribution and process diagnostics further ask what observed returns reveal about agent behavior ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Qu and Chen, 2026 ) . OpenFinGym broadens this setting to executable tasks derived from financial publications, with verifiers and controls separating agent-accessible information from evaluation outcomes ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 交易智能体与量化因子研究。 金融智能体评估将决策与其在动态环境中的后果联系起来。 InvestorBench 和 StockBench 中的序列投资评估已扩展至 DeepFund、LiveTradeBench 和 AI-Trader 中的实时市场评估（Li et al., 2025b；Chen et al., 2025；Li et al., 2025a；Yu et al., 2025；Fan et al., 2025）。 能力归因与过程诊断进一步探讨了观测到的回报揭示了智能体行为的哪些信息（Zhu et al., 2026；Qu and Chen, 2026）。 OpenFinGym 将这一场景扩展至源自金融出版物可执行的任务，并通过验证器和控制机制将智能体可访问的信息与评估结果分离开来（Zhang et al., 2026a）。

paragraphs.en: Factor research gives agents control over the predictive artifact itself, including its hypothesis, implementation, and revision. Search has expanded from mathematical expressions to executable programs and iterative procedures informed by accumulated experience ( Yu et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025c ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Evaluation consequently covers iterative search and its cost in AlphaBench, executable strategy construction in AlphaForgeBench, and financial, semantic, and structural quality in AlphaEval and AlphaQT-Bench ( Luo et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Ding et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026b ) . AlphaBench already preserves evaluation history and the best factor across rounds in its chain-of-experience search. Building on these iterative research settings, our focus is how base-model capability changes the marginal value of additional sequential experimentation. Our work crosses models with research budgets to examine whether deeper search improves held-out factor quality, closes capability gaps, and offers favorable trade-offs in realized cost.
paragraphs.zh: 因子研究使智能体能够控制预测性产物本身，包括其假设、实现和修订。 搜索范围已从数学表达式扩展到可执行程序和由积累经验指导的迭代过程（Yu et al., 2023；Li et al., 2025c；Liu et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026）。 因此，评估涵盖了 AlphaBench 中的迭代搜索及其成本、AlphaForgeBench 中的可执行策略构建，以及 AlphaEval 和 AlphaQT-Bench 中的财务、语义和结构质量（Luo et al., 2026a；Zhang et al., 2026b；Ding et al., 2026；Luo et al., 2026b）。 AlphaBench 已在其经验链搜索中保存了评估历史和各轮的最佳因子。 基于这些迭代研究设置，我们的重点是基础模型能力如何改变额外序列实验的边际价值。 我们的工作跨越不同模型和研究预算，旨在检验更深入的搜索是否能提升保留因子的质量、缩小能力差距，并在实际成本方面带来有利的权衡。

paragraphs.en: An external harness loop advances each model–task pair along a single research trajectory. Each loop invocation permits one research cycle in which the agent can act on its current state, run experiments, inspect development-period feedback, and update its candidate. paragraphs.en: The main experiment comprises comparing model performance across nine models: Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) , DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ( DeepSeek, 2026 ) , DeepSeek-V4-Pro ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , Doubao Seed 2.1 Pro, GLM-5.2 and GLM-5.3 ( GLM-5 Team, 2026 ) , MiniMax-M3 ( Lai et al., 2026 ) , Qwen3.7-Plus ( Alibaba Cloud, 2026 ) , and DeepSeek-V3.1 ( DeepSeek, 2025 ) . We use Claude Code (v2.1.209) as the agent harness, and we launch it in bare mode to avoid the undesired impact of extensions, skills, or persistent memory on model behavior. For each model–task pair, the harness runs one continuous 10-iteration trajectory and saves a checkpoint after every iteration. The agent receives development feedback, while checkpoints are evaluated independently outside the agent workspace. Each model is evaluated five times on the 50 tasks, and the reported final score is the arithmetic mean of the five run-level scores, reducing sensitivity to a single stochastic trajectory. Runtime limits and state handling appear in Appendix D ; the fixed mining and audit prompts are reported in Appendix D.2 and Appendix C.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 主要实验包括对九个模型的性能进行比较：Claude Opus 5（Anthropic，2026）、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash（DeepSeek，2026）、DeepSeek-V4-Pro（DeepSeek-AI，2026）、Doubao Seed 2.1 Pro、GLM-5.2 和 GLM-5.3（GLM-5 Team，2026）、MiniMax-M3（Lai 等，2026）、Qwen3.7-Plus（Alibaba Cloud，2026）以及 DeepSeek-V3.1（DeepSeek，2025）。 我们将 Claude Code（v2.1.209）用作智能体框架，并以裸机模式启动它，以避免扩展、技能或持久性记忆对模型行为产生不良影响。 对于每个模型-任务组合，该框架会运行一个包含 10 次迭代的连续轨迹，并在每次迭代后保存一个检查点。 智能体接收开发反馈，而检查点则在智能体工作区之外独立进行评估。 每个模型在 50 个任务上均被评估五次，所报告的最终分数是五次运行级别分数的算术平均值，从而降低对单次随机轨迹的敏感性。 运行时限制和状态处理见附录 D；固定的挖掘和审计提示词则分别报告在附录 D.2 和附录 C.4 中。

paragraphs.en: Each submitted factor is evaluated on three complementary aspects of quality. Net Sharpe ratio measures the risk-adjusted performance of the long–short portfolio constructed from the factor, monotonicity measures how consistently factor-sorted portfolios are ordered by the signal, and idea alignment measures the fidelity of the implementation to the assigned economic hypothesis. The task-level metrics are aggregated into the model-level score; GPT-5.6 Sol audits temporal validity and alignment independently of the tested models, and the scoring rubric is in Appendix C . Actual API expenditure provides cost per task.
paragraphs.zh: 每个提交的因子都会从三个互补的质量维度进行评估。 净夏普比率衡量由该因子构建的多空头寸组合的风险调整后表现，单调性衡量按因子排序的投资组合是否始终按照信号顺序排列，而观点一致性则衡量实施过程对指定经济假设的忠实程度。 任务级指标会被汇总为模型级得分；GPT-5.6 Sol 会独立于受测模型审计时间有效性和对齐性，评分标准见附录 C。 实际 API 支出提供了每项任务的成本。

paragraphs.en: All models improve from three to ten iterations, but the returns to additional search differ substantially. Table 1 reports the nine models at their recorded checkpoints. Claude Opus 5 rises from 75.45 to 92.50, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash from 65.35 to 83.44, and MiniMax-M3 from 37.35 to 55.99. Their paths differ: Claude Opus 5 approaches its ten-iteration result by iteration 6, whereas DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and MiniMax-M3 continue to gain later. paragraphs.en: Section 4.2 shows that additional depth improves every model, but leaves open what makes iterative search effective. We therefore conduct two controlled experiments: model grafting separates the value of an early research state from the capability of the model that continues it, and a sequential–parallel comparison tests whether spending the same total budget on several independent searches outperforms deepening a single trajectory. In the grafting experiment, we transfer the accumulated factor, development evidence, and research memory between GLM-5.3 and Qwen3.7-Plus at iteration 3, then let the receiving model continue for seven further iterations under the ten-iteration total budget. Table 2 reports both transfer directions.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4.2 节表明，增加深度能提升所有模型的性能，但尚未阐明迭代搜索有效性的具体原因。 因此，我们进行了两项受控实验：通过模型嫁接，将早期研究状态的价值与其后续延续模型的能力区分开来；并通过顺序-并行比较，检验将相同总预算分配给多个独立搜索，是否比加深单一路径更优。 在嫁接实验中，我们在第 3 次迭代时将累积因子、开发证据和研究记忆在 GLM-5.3 与 Qwen3.7-Plus 之间进行转移，然后让接收模型在总共十次迭代的预算限制下继续运行七次迭代。 表 2 报告了两种转移方向的结果。

paragraphs.en: Comparing Claude Opus 5 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with the lower-scoring MiniMax-M3 and DeepSeek-V3.1 on matched fundamental and technical tasks reveals differences in how agents redirect search. The higher-scoring models move from local parameter tuning to changes in measurement, component construction, or aggregation when diagnostics undermine the current approach. In lower-scoring trajectories, successive window, smoothing, and threshold changes can continue around the same representation, with disappointing results attributed to an economic ceiling. The distinction is whether a plateau changes the agent’s account of the problem and the scope of its next experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 在匹配的基础理论和技术任务中，将 Claude Opus 5 和 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 与得分较低的 MiniMax-M3 和 DeepSeek-V3.1 进行比较，可以发现智能体在重新引导搜索方式上的差异。 当诊断结果削弱当前方法时，得分较高的模型会从局部参数调整转向对测量、组件构建或聚合方式的调整。 在得分较低的轨迹中，连续的调整窗口、平滑和阈值可能围绕相同的表示持续进行，而令人失望的结果则归因于经济天花板。 区别在于，平台期是否改变了智能体对问题的描述以及其下一次实验的范围。

paragraphs.en: Feedback attribution also differs. Claude Opus 5 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash inspect component contributions, gross versus net returns, coverage, and implementation consistency before deciding which change to retain. Their records include corrections to earlier explanations after controlled comparisons contradict them. MiniMax-M3 and DeepSeek-V3.1 also attempt structural changes, but some trajectories revise several assumptions together or interpret sign reversals as evidence against the economic hypothesis before resolving construction errors. Such misattribution spends additional search on the wrong cause and can make a viable direction appear exhausted.

paragraphs.en: Candidate selection determines how much of the search translates into the final score. The higher-scoring model records include retaining earlier candidates after failed revisions and rejecting higher-Sharpe variants that remove an economically required adjustment. paragraphs.en: Grafting shows that progress can survive a change of model through the inherited implementation, evidence, and research memory. With model weights fixed, this state changes what subsequent decisions condition on, so an early implementation has downstream value through both its current performance and the experiments it makes informative. The advantage of parallel search further indicates that a useful starting direction can matter more than extending the history of one trajectory. Search-state quality therefore concerns whether accumulated evidence supports better decisions, rather than how much history is retained.

This explains how a model can be a useful continuation agent despite weaker independent performance. A low standalone score can conceal competent refinement, while a strong standalone model can still struggle to recover from a poorly initialized trajectory. paragraphs.en: Search scaling should transfer when tasks provide informative external feedback, persistent artifacts, incremental revision, and independent final evaluation. Factor research and code optimization meet these conditions; repeatable data analysis and scientific modeling may also do so. paragraphs.en: We studied how search depth changes out-of-sample quality in autonomous quantitative factor mining and how its returns interact with model capability and search organization. Measurements along continuous trajectories separate nominal iteration budgets from realized resources, and cross-model curves with the empirical search scaling law in Appendix D.4 show that starting quality and continued-search gains vary across models. Model grafting and sequential–parallel interventions reveal that early research states can retain value across model switches and that broader exploration can outperform extending one trajectory. Autonomous research scaling therefore depends on the amount of computation, the research state it creates, and how later computation is allocated across directions and stages.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了搜索深度如何影响自主量化因子挖掘中的样本外质量，以及其收益如何与模型能力和搜索组织方式相互作用。 沿连续轨迹的测量将名义迭代预算与实际资源区分开来，而附录 D.4 中与经验搜索扩展定律对应的跨模型曲线表明，初始质量和持续搜索带来的增益在不同模型之间存在差异。 模型嫁接和序列-并行干预表明，早期的研究状态可以在模型切换中保留价值，并且更广泛的探索可能比延长单一轨迹更为有效。 因此，自主研究的扩展取决于计算量、其产生的研究状态，以及后续计算如何在不同方向和阶段之间分配。

paragraphs.en: The source corpus consists of quantitative research reports issued by multiple sell-side brokerages between February 2017 and June 2024. We retained reports about a single factor whose main contribution was factor construction followed by a single-factor backtest, with an explicit construction formula and Chinese A-share stocks as the investment universe. Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) performed an initial screening; human quantitative experts then reviewed the candidates and selected 50 reports. The final set contains 30 technical and 20 fundamental tasks, spanning daily and intraday inputs and multiple proposed sources of alpha. Table A.1 and Table A.2 summarize the two task groups by signal family and input frequency.
paragraphs.zh: 源语料库由多家卖方券商在 2017 年 2 月至 2024 年 6 月期间发布的定量研究报告组成。 我们保留了关于单一因子的报告，这些报告的主要贡献是因子构建，随后进行单因子回测，并包含明确的构建公式以及以中国 A 股股票为投资范围的内容。 Claude Opus 5（Anthropic，2026）进行了初步筛选；随后，人类量化专家对候选报告进行了审核，并从中挑选出 50 份报告。 最终集合包含 30 项技术类任务和 20 项基本面任务，涵盖每日和日内输入数据，以及多种拟议的阿尔法来源。 表 A.1 和表 A.2 按信号类别和输入频率对这两组任务进行了总结。

paragraphs.en: You are a quantitative factor researcher generating a factor-mining task for the benchmark. Do not write code. Produce a clear factor-research direction for a subsequent mining loop to implement and evaluate. # Source for this idea {source_block} # Available data The following data block is generated from `catalog.json` and is always current: {data_block} See `data_catalog.md` for field units, caveats, and point-in-time (PIT) rules. The available-data information is for reference. You are not required to use only the listed data when generating an idea. The downstream mining loop will handle data availability; do not let it determine the idea. # Requirements 1. First use Bash/Read to inspect the provided `factor.py`, `card.md`, and `metrics.json` examples and the candidate records to avoid duplicates. 2. If useful, search the web to understand the current research on related factors, such as how a factor family has performed in the A-share market. 3. Produce a **concrete, implementable** factor idea. Its core should be the **calculation logic or formula**: which fields to use, how to combine them into a signal, and what the signal is expected to mean for stock selection. Provide enough information to implement the logic; do not be vague. At the same time, avoid unnecessary implementation detail. A broad formula and its economic mechanism are generally enough; mention important pitfalls only if helpful. Do not specify details as narrowly as "revenue growth g_0 = S_0/S_{{-1}} - 1, clipped to [-0.5, 1.0]; clipping is mandatory because an extreme AR(1) starting value would destabilize the accounting path." Excessive detail restricts the later mining agent’s choices. A good idea has the following style: ``` Construct a turnover-weighted short-term reversal factor from daily close and turnover_ratio. Use approximately 20 trading days in the window t-21 to t-1, skipping the most recent day to reduce bid-ask-bounce noise. Compute each day’s return r_d = pct_change and turnover to_d; set w_d = to_d / sum(to_d) and wret = sum(r_d * w_d), so days with high turnover receive more weight. Define the factor as -wret / (standard deviation of daily returns in the window + 1e-6). A high value indicates a stock sold sharply on high-turnover, high-attention days and therefore a potential rebound; a low value indicates a stock bid up on high-turnover days and therefore a potential reversal.
paragraphs.zh: 你是一名量化因子研究员，正在为基准测试生成一个因子挖掘任务。不要编写代码。 提出一个清晰的因子研究方向，供后续挖掘循环实施和评估。# 该思路的来源 {source_block} # 可用数据 以下数据块来自 `catalog.json` 且始终为最新状态：{data_block} 字段单位、注意事项及特定时间点（PIT）规则请参见 `data_catalog.md`。 可用数据信息仅供参考。 生成思路时，不必仅限于使用所列出的数据。 下游挖掘循环将处理数据可用性；不要让可用性决定思路本身。# 要求 1. 首先使用 Bash/Read 检查提供的 `factor.py`、`card.md` 和 `metrics.json` 示例以及候选记录，以避免重复。2. 如有必要，可搜索网络了解相关因子的当前研究进展，例如某个因子家族在 A 股市场的表现。3. 提出一个**具体且可实施的**因子思路。 其核心应为**计算逻辑或公式**：使用哪些字段、如何将其组合成信号，以及该信号对选股意味着什么。 提供足够的信息以实现该逻辑；避免含糊不清。 同时，避免不必要的实现细节。 一个宽泛的公式及其经济机制通常已足够；仅在必要时提及重要陷阱。 不要将细节规定得过细，例如“收入增长 g_0 = S_0/S_{{-1}} - 1，并裁剪至 [-0.5, 1.0]；必须裁剪，因为极端的 AR(1) 初始值会破坏会计路径的稳定性。”过多的细节会限制后续挖掘智能体的选择空间。 一个优秀的思路通常具有以下风格：``` 基于每日收盘价和 turnover_ratio 构建一个周转率加权短期反转因子。 在窗口 t-21 至 t-1 中使用约 20 个交易日，跳过最新一天以减少买卖价差反弹噪声。 每日计算收益率 r_d = pct_change 和周转率 to_d；设置 w_d = to_d / sum(to_d) 和 wret = sum(r_d * w_d)，使高周转率的交易日获得更高权重。 将因子定义为 -wret /（窗口内每日收益率的标准差 + 1e-6）。 高值表明股票在高周转率、高关注度的交易日大幅下跌，因此可能反弹；低值表明股票在高周转率交易日被推高，因此可能反转。

paragraphs.en: Human reviewers retained objectives that were self-contained and specific enough to identify the required financial quantities, construction logic, signal direction, and economic mechanism. paragraphs.en: The evaluation universe comprises approximately 5,200 stocks listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen exchanges. At each signal date, the engine excludes special-treatment (ST) stocks and stocks with fewer than 60 days of listing history. The training (factor-development) period is January 1, 2013 through June 30, 2024, and the held-out test period is July 1, 2024 through July 17, 2026. Because every source report was published by June 2024, the test period contains only market observations subsequent to the report corpus. This temporal separation prevents look-ahead from report-derived task information and makes the reported financial evaluation out of sample. Daily price and volume data, intraday bars, industry classifications, valuation data, forecasts, preliminary earnings disclosures, and the three principal financial statements are available through a shared catalog. These inputs allow agents to construct factors from different economic and market mechanisms within the same equity universe.
paragraphs.zh: 评估范围涵盖在上海和深圳交易所上市的约 5,200 只股票。 在每个信号日，系统会排除特殊处理（ST）股票以及上市时间不足 60 天的股票。 训练（因子开发）期为 2013 年 1 月 1 日至 2024 年 6 月 30 日，保留测试期为 2024 年 7 月 1 日至 2026 年 7 月 17 日。 由于所有来源报告均于 2024 年 6 月前发布，测试期仅包含报告语料发布后的市场观察数据。 这种时间上的分离避免了利用报告衍生任务信息进行的提前预测，并使所报告的财务评估成为样本外数据。 每日价格和成交量数据、日内 K 线、行业分类、估值数据、预测、初步盈利披露以及三大主要财务报表均可通过共享目录获取。 这些输入使智能体能够在同一股票范围内，基于不同的经济和市场机制构建因子。

paragraphs.en: For a signal dated T T , the factor interface supplies daily observations only through T T . Fundamental records are selected according to their publication dates, so the agent receives records available by T T rather than a subsequently revised full-history panel. The audit separately checks whether submitted code bypasses this interface or otherwise introduces information unavailable at the signal date. This separation is material for accounting tasks: a correctly written formula can still be invalid if it uses a later disclosure as though it were known earlier.
paragraphs.zh: 对于日期为 T T 的信号，因子接口仅通过 T T 提供每日观测数据。 基础记录根据其发布日期进行选择，因此智能体接收的是截至 T T 可用的记录，而非后续修订的完整历史面板数据。 审计将单独检查所提交的代码是否绕过了该接口，或以其他方式引入了在信号日期尚未可用的信息。 这种分离对会计任务至关重要：即使公式编写正确，如果它使用了后续披露的信息并假装这些信息在更早时已知，则仍然可能无效。

paragraphs.en: An agent submits an executable cross-sectional factor and the signal matrix produced from it. It chooses historical windows, field combinations, treatment of missing and extreme values, and postprocessing appropriate to the hypothesis. The common default postprocessing winsorizes the raw cross-section, removes industry and size exposures, and centers ranks. Agents may replace the default specification; the submitted postprocessing is retained with the artifact so that the evaluated signal can be interpreted together with the raw construction.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体提交一个可执行的横截面因子以及由此生成的信号矩阵。 它会根据假设选择历史窗口、字段组合、缺失值与极端值的处理方法，以及适当的后处理步骤。 常见的默认后处理方法会对原始横截面数据进行分位数截断，移除行业和规模暴露，并对排名进行中心化处理。 智能体可以替换默认规格；提交的后处理方法会与成果一同保留，以便能够将评估出的信号与原始构建过程结合解读。

paragraphs.en: The agent begins in a fresh workspace containing the data catalog, documentation, common tools, and fixed implementation examples. It does not receive the broader factor library or prior performance records. Thus a task describes a construction objective, while the agent must turn that description into an executable factor and diagnose the effects of its own implementation and processing choices.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体从一个包含数据目录、文档、常用工具和固定实现示例的全新工作区开始。 它不会获得更广泛的因子库或过往的性能记录。 因此，一项任务描述的是一个构建目标，而智能体必须将这一描述转化为可执行的因子，并诊断自身实现和处理选择所带来的影响。

paragraphs.en: Signals formed at the close of trading day T T determine positions entered at the open of T + 1 T+1 and closed at the open of T + 2 T+2 . The main long–short portfolio assigns centered cross-sectional rank weights, normalized to zero net exposure and unit gross exposure. Daily turnover is the sum of absolute changes in those weights. Net returns deduct 5 basis points on purchases and 15 basis points on sales. The evaluator also sorts stocks into ten factor-ranked groups and records each group’s annualized return for the monotonicity calculation.
paragraphs.zh: 在 T 日交易收盘时形成的信号，决定了在 T+1 日开盘时建仓以及在 T+2 日开盘时平仓的仓位。 主要多空投资组合分配居中的横截面排名权重，并归一化为零净敞度和单位总敞度。 每日换手率是这些权重绝对变化值的总和。 净回报在买入时扣除 5 个基点，在卖出时扣除 15 个基点。 评估者还将股票按因子排名分为十个组别，并记录每个组别的年化回报率，用于单调性计算。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark recomputes financial metrics from the submitted signal in the common evaluator rather than accepting a metric file produced inside the agent’s workspace. Agents receive backtest feedback only from the training period. Once an artifact is selected, the evaluator applies it to the held-out test period without returning those results for further revision. This ensures that agent-side changes to scoring code cannot redefine the reported outcome and that test performance remains out of sample. The implementation audit uses the submitted code and objective to assess temporal validity and semantic alignment. Financial metrics and audit findings are retained separately so that a profitable but invalid or off-objective artifact remains inspectable.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试会在通用评估器中基于提交的信号重新计算财务指标，而不是接受智能体工作空间内部生成的指标文件。 智能体仅从训练阶段获得回测反馈。 一旦选定某个成果物，评估器便会将其应用于预留的测试阶段，且不会返回这些结果以供进一步修改。 这确保了智能体端对评分代码的修改无法重新定义报告的结果，同时测试表现也保持为样本外数据。 实现审计会使用提交的代码和目标来评估时间有效性及语义一致性。 财务指标与审计结果会被分别保留，以便即使某个成果物能盈利但无效或偏离目标，也能继续被检查。

paragraphs.en: The alignment judgment considers both fidelity to the assigned research hypothesis and the economic interpretability of the resulting factor. It does not require a verbatim reproduction of the provided idea: changes that retain the hypothesis and have a coherent economic rationale are allowed. This criterion instead prevents historical backtest optimization from replacing the assigned hypothesis with unrelated predictors. A rating of 5 means the core single-factor idea is faithfully implemented without unrelated signals; 3–4 allows minor interpretable additions; 1–2 reflects substantial dilution by unrelated predictors; and 0 denotes little connection to the objective. The audit records a rationale and identifies any drift signals.
paragraphs.zh: 对齐性评估既考虑对指定研究假设的忠实度，也考虑所得因子的经济可解释性。 它不要求逐字复现所提供的观点：只要保留原假设且具备连贯的经济逻辑，允许进行改动。 相反，这一标准能防止历史回测优化用无关预测变量取代指定的假设。 5分表示核心单因子观点得到了忠实实现，且没有无关信号；3至4分允许少量可解释的补充；1至2分反映被无关预测变量显著稀释；0分则表示与目标几乎没有关联。 审计会记录评估理由，并识别任何偏离原目标的信号。

Assess temporal validity and idea alignment, then return one structured JSON object. # Factor under review - Factor implementation: `{factor_filename}` - Read this file first. If the data interface requires clarification, read `factor_base.py`, which defines the factor interface. # Point-in-time guarantee provided by the framework The point-in-time (PIT) boundary is enforced in `loader.py`. At each signal date T, the factor receives daily matrices truncated at T, fundamental and forecast records filtered by publication date, and the eligible universe at T. Historical calculations that remain inside this time-bounded interface, including rolling statistics and shifts to earlier observations, are temporally valid. # Dimension A: future-information leakage The central question is whether the implementation escapes the time-bounded interface. Review the code line by line and reason about the following indicators: - File I/O such as `open`, `pd.read_parquet`, `pd.read_csv`, `glob`, or direct use of `os` or `pathlib` to load data. - Imports outside `factor_base`, `numpy`, `pandas`, `scipy`, and `math`. Importing `loader`, `DataLoader`, or another data-access module escapes the interface. - Direct references to `DataLoader`, loader objects, or full-history matrices. - Absolute paths, parent-directory traversal, hard-coded dates, `datetime.now()`, or fixed timestamps that introduce information unavailable at T. - Forward-looking operators such as negative shifts or indices aligned to future returns or prices. A negative shift within a truncated historical window may only create missing values, so determine whether the code actually accesses data after T. - Any external state that would not be known at T. Decision rules: - If the factor uses only the time-bounded interface and the allowed libraries, with no effective access to future information, set `verdict` to `PASS`. - If the code accesses information outside the time-bounded interface, set `verdict` to `FAIL`. - Do not flag valid historical rolling calculations, `iloc[-1]`, or positive shifts. - For a failure, explain the causal path to leakage and list each finding with its severity and line number.

paragraphs.en: # Dimension B: alignment with the assigned idea {idea_block} Assess whether the implementation preserves the assigned factor direction or combines it with unrelated sources of signal. - Core criterion: a single-factor task should not mix the intended signal with independent predictors. For example, adding reversal, momentum, or turnover components to a profitability-quality idea without a hypothesis-consistent reason constitutes drift. - Supporting evidence: economic interpretability and a coherent formula support alignment. paragraphs.en: You are a quant researcher. Your objective is to do factor mining according to the idea provided. You should implement and test a candidate, interpret the evidence, update the research memory, and yield a delivery as your submission. # Factor idea {idea} # Research cycle 1. Inspect the current state. - Read `{memory_file}` and the existing candidate files. - On the first invocation, read the provided `factor.py` examples to learn the required implementation interface. 2. Implement or revise the candidate in `factor.py`. 3. Run the common backtest: `python backtest.py --factor <name> --start {bt_start} --end {bt_end} --deciles 10` - Use the fixed interval `{bt_start}` through `{bt_end}` for any recorded candidate. - The engine enforces a `{bt_time_limit}`-minute safety limit for an individual backtest. - You may use a shorter interval with `--no-save` for a runtime probe. Such a probe is not a candidate result; a recorded version must use the fixed interval. - Control concurrency and memory use. 4. Read `report.md`, including the validity decision, long-short metrics, decile returns, and plots. Diagnose both the implementation and the economic hypothesis. 5. Append the cycle to `{memory_file}` with the candidate filename, PASS/FAIL result, key metrics, diagnosis, and the next research decision. 6. Select the strongest current candidate that remains temporally valid and aligned with the assigned idea. Copy its complete file set into the delivery submission for this checkpoint. Within this cycle, you may perform several tool calls, code edits, runtime probes, or backtests when they are needed to diagnose a candidate. Do not end the invocation without a completed recorded backtest and an updated incumbent submission. # Research principles - The final factor is intended for investment research. Do not improve historical metrics through formula hacks, future data, or signals unrelated to the assigned idea. - Interpret the full report. Sharpe is the primary risk-adjusted return measure, while decile ordering and long- and short-side excess returns help diagnose where the factor works or fails. - When evidence contradicts the current explanation, revise the construction or change direction within the assigned hypothesis. Preserve a stronger prior incumbent if a new candidate degrades the evidence. - Keep the implementation economically interpretable. A higher backtest metric does not justify hypothesis drift.
paragraphs.zh: 你是一名量化研究员。 你的目标是根据所提供的思路进行因子挖掘。 你应该实现并测试一个候选方案，解读证据，更新研究记忆，并以交付成果作为提交内容。# 因子思路 {idea} # 研究周期 1。 检查当前状态。 - 读取 `{memory_file}` 和现有的候选文件。 - 在首次调用时，读取提供的 `factor.py` 示例以了解所需的实现接口。 2. 在 `factor.py` 中实现或修改候选方案。 3. 运行通用回测：`python backtest.py --factor <name> --start {bt_start} --end {bt_end} --deciles 10` - 对任何已记录的候选方案，使用固定的时间区间 `{bt_start}` 到 `{bt_end}`。 - 引擎会为单次回测强制执行 `{bt_time_limit}` 分钟的安全限制。 - 你可以使用更短的时间区间并配合 `--no-save` 进行运行时探测。 此类探测并非候选方案的结果；已记录的版本必须使用固定的时间区间。 - 控制并发性和内存使用。 4. 读取 `report.md`，包括有效性判定、多空策略指标、十分位收益率和图表。 诊断实现部分和经济假设。 5. 将本周期信息追加到 `{memory_file}` 中，内容包括候选文件名、通过/失败结果、关键指标、诊断结论以及下一步研究决策。 6. 选择当前最强且仍在时间上有效并与指定思路一致的候选方案。 将其完整的文件集复制到本次检查点的交付提交中。 在本周期内，当需要诊断候选方案时，你可以执行多次工具调用、代码编辑、运行时探测或回测。 未完成已记录的回测和更新后的当前最佳提交内容，不得结束调用。# 研究原则 - 最终因子用于投资研究。 不得通过公式技巧、未来数据或与指定思路无关的信号来优化历史指标。 - 解读完整的报告。 夏普比率是主要的风险调整后收益指标，而十分位排序以及多空策略的超额收益有助于诊断因子在何处有效或失效。 - 当证据与当前解释矛盾时，应修改构建方式或在指定假设内调整方向。 如果新候选方案削弱了证据，则保留更优的先前最佳方案。 - 保持实现的经济可解释性。 更高的回测指标并不构成改变假设的理由。

paragraphs.en: # Computational requirements - Declare only the required data fields using the metadata described in `data_catalog.md`. Loading an entire table wastes the backtest budget. - Intraday data are expensive. Use the coarsest available channel that supports the hypothesis and request only needed fields. - Restrict the historical window to the observations required by the construction. - Cache reusable rolling intermediates through the framework’s incremental-computation interface. - Prefer vectorized NumPy or pandas operations over loops across stocks. - Use the timing breakdown in the backtest log to diagnose data loading, factor computation, postprocessing, or evaluation bottlenecks. # Temporal validity and idea alignment - Access data only through the time-bounded factor interface. Do not read data files directly with `read_parquet`, `read_csv`, `open`, or `glob`; do not import `loader` or `DataLoader`; do not use absolute paths, parent-directory traversal, hard-coded evaluation dates, or operators aligned to future observations. - The implementation must remain faithful to the assigned idea. Minor and economically interpretable additions are allowed, but do not add independent reversal, momentum, turnover, valuation, or other predictors merely to raise the backtest score. Hypothesis-consistent transformations and postprocessing choices are allowed when they remain economically interpretable. # Workspace boundary Use only the files supplied in the benchmark workspace; do not access external files. - Write the candidate to `factor.py` and research memory to `{memory_file}`. - Do not modify the framework source files; they define the common evaluation environment. - Do not modify the shared `postprocess.toml`. paragraphs.en: Higher-scoring behavior: Claude Opus 5 on burst_support_imb . The model first tested whether a longer aggregation window could jointly reduce turnover and improve measurement precision. Here, W W is the lookback window in trading days, and Q Q is the intraday volume-quantile threshold used to identify unusually large trades. When the result showed that lower turnover came with proportional alpha decay, the model stopped searching that axis and moved to structural changes in trading frequency and signal normalization.
paragraphs.zh: 得分更高的行为：Claude Opus 5 在 burst_support_imb 上的表现。 该模型首先测试了更长的聚合窗口是否能够同时降低换手率并提高测量精度。 此处，W W 是以交易天为单位的历史回顾窗口，而 Q Q 是用于识别异常大额交易的日内成交量分位数阈值。 当结果显示较低的换手率伴随着比例性的阿尔法衰减时，模型便停止在该维度上继续搜索，转而研究交易频率和信号归一化的结构性变化。

paragraphs.en: Iteration 2. Extending W W from 40 to 80 reduced turnover by 31%, but gross annual return also fell by 20%; net Sharpe was essentially unchanged at 1.368 versus 1.336. The signal has a real decay horizon. W W is not the way forward, so I will not spend another iteration testing W = 20 W=20 .

paragraphs.en: Iteration 4. Both W W and Q Q are exhausted, and the remaining bottleneck is structural rather than parametric. I will test weekly signal refresh, because the idea describes a persistent behavioral characteristic that need not be traded every day, and replace the bounded ratio with share-normalized signed burst volume. Weekly refresh reduced turnover from 14.6% to 8.3% and raised net Sharpe from 1.368 to 1.753; share normalization raised it to 2.565.
paragraphs.zh: 迭代 4。 W W 和 Q Q 均已耗尽，而剩余的瓶颈是结构性的，而非参数性的。 我将测试每周信号刷新，因为这一理念描述的是一种持续的行为特征，无需每日交易，并将有界比率替换为按股份归一化的带符号爆发成交量。 每周刷新将换手率从 14.6% 降至 8.3%，并将净夏普指数从 1.368 提升至 1.753；按股份归一化后，该指数进一步升至 2.565。

sents.en: Iteration 4.
sents.zh: 迭代 4。

sents.en: Both W W and Q Q are exhausted, and the remaining bottleneck is structural rather than parametric.
sents.zh: W W 和 Q Q 均已耗尽，而剩余的瓶颈是结构性的，而非参数性的。

sents.en: I will test weekly signal refresh, because the idea describes a persistent behavioral characteristic that need not be traded every day, and replace the bounded ratio with share-normalized signed burst volume.

paragraphs.en: Lower-scoring behavior: MiniMax-M3 on sharp_minute_impact_persist . The model correctly identified turnover as a bottleneck, but successive revisions continued to smooth the same impact-persistence representation by enlarging its aggregation window. Here, W W again denotes the lookback window in trading days.
paragraphs.zh: 得分较低的行为：sharp_minute_impact_persist 上的 MiniMax-M3。 该模型正确识别出员工流动率是瓶颈，但后续的修订版本通过扩大聚合窗口，持续对相同的影响持久性表示进行平滑处理。 此处，W W 再次表示以交易天为单位的历史回顾窗口。

paragraphs.zh: 迭代 4。 对 W = 40 天内的分子和分母进行汇总可以减少噪声，但净夏普比率仍为 −0.275，换手率为 14.25%。 信号确实存在，但强度不足以覆盖成本。

paragraphs.en: Iterations 5–6. Increasing W W to 60 and changing the retained intraday observations raises gross Sharpe but lowers net Sharpe to − 0.365 -0.365 and monotonicity to 0.806. Extending W W again to 100 reduces turnover to 7.78% and makes net Sharpe positive at 0.332, while monotonicity remains 0.806. The next step is to keep working on the window and extreme-observation treatment.
paragraphs.zh: 迭代 5–6。 将 W W 增加到 60，并更改保留的日内观测数据，会提高总夏普比率，但使净夏普比率降至 −0.365，单调性降至 0.806。 再次将 W W 扩展到 100，可将换手率降至 7.78%，并使净夏普比率变为正数（0.332），而单调性仍为 0.806。 下一步是继续优化窗口和极端观测值的处理方法。

sents.en: Iterations 5–6.
Increasing W W to 60 and changing the retained intraday observations raises gross Sharpe but lowers net Sharpe to − 0.365 -0.365 and monotonicity to 0.806.
sents.zh: 将 W W 增加到 60，并更改保留的日内观测数据，会提高总夏普比率，但使净夏普比率降至 −0.365，单调性降至 0.806。

paragraphs.en: The later experiments repeatedly trade signal sharpness for lower turnover along the same smoothing axis. Even after monotonicity deteriorates, the next decision remains another window or extreme-value adjustment rather than a new explanation of the factor’s weak economic separation.
paragraphs.zh: 后续的实验沿着相同的平滑轴，反复以牺牲信号清晰度为代价来换取更低的换手率。 即使单调性已经恶化，下一个决策仍然是一个新的窗口或极值调整，而不是对该因素较弱的经济分离性做出新的解释。

paragraphs.en: Lower-scoring behavior: DeepSeek-V3.1 on pullup_granularity_asym . Early rounds attributed weak results to regression, volume weighting, temporal smoothing, and economic sign. A later implementation check revealed that the code had sliced stocks rather than dates, invalidating those interpretations. EWMA denotes an exponentially weighted moving average, and WINDOW is the intended number of historical dates in the aggregation.
paragraphs.zh: 得分较低的行为：DeepSeek-V3.1 在 pullup_granularity_asym 上的表现。 早期阶段将结果偏弱归因于回归、体积加权、时间平滑和经济符号。 一次后续的实现检查发现，代码实际上对股票进行了切片而非日期，这使得上述解释无效。 EWMA 表示指数加权移动平均，而 WINDOW 是聚合过程中预期的历史日期数量。

sents.zh: 移除它们后，信号恢复了预期的方向和单调性，而 EWMA 平滑效果则糟糕至极。

sents.en: The direction is exhausted after these alternatives fail.
sents.zh: 在这些替代方案都失败之后，方向性已完全耗尽。

paragraphs.en: Iteration 5. A serious bug was found: a.iloc[-WINDOW:] selected the last 20 stock rows rather than the last 20 date columns. Every earlier version was therefore computed from only 20 stocks and its result is unreliable.
paragraphs.zh: 迭代 5。 发现了一个严重错误：a.iloc[-WINDOW:] 选择了最后 20 行股票数据，而不是最后 20 列日期数据。 因此，所有早期版本都仅基于 20 只股票进行计算，其结果并不可靠。

sents.en: Iteration 5.
sents.zh: 迭代 5。

sents.en: A serious bug was found: a.iloc[-WINDOW:] selected the last 20 stock rows rather than the last 20 date columns.
sents.zh: 发现了一个严重错误：a.iloc[-WINDOW:] 选择了最后 20 行股票数据，而不是最后 20 列日期数据。

sents.en: Every earlier version was therefore computed from only 20 stocks and its result is unreliable.
sents.zh: 因此，所有早期版本都仅基于 20 只股票进行计算，其结果并不可靠。

paragraphs.en: Iteration 6. After correcting the slice and rerunning the factor, the raw signal predicts in the opposite direction from the research hypothesis. What had been interpreted as overreaction is better described in these data as concentrated buying followed by continuation.
paragraphs.zh: 迭代 6。 在修正切片并重新运行因子后，原始信号的预测方向与研究假设相反。 这些数据表明，此前被解释为过度反应的现象，更应描述为集中买入后的持续走势。

sents.en: Iteration 6.
sents.zh: 迭代 6。

sents.en: After correcting the slice and rerunning the factor, the raw signal predicts in the opposite direction from the research hypothesis.
sents.zh: 在修正切片并重新运行因子后，原始信号的预测方向与研究假设相反。

sents.en: What had been interpreted as overreaction is better described in these data as concentrated buying followed by continuation.
sents.zh: 这些数据表明，此前被解释为过度反应的现象，更应描述为集中买入后的持续走势。

paragraphs.en: Because the construction error was discovered only after several economic explanations had been formed, the earlier feedback was attributed to mechanisms that the implemented experiment did not actually test.
paragraphs.zh: 由于建造错误是在形成数个经济解释之后才发现的，因此早期的反馈被归因于实际实施的实验并未真正检验的机制。

paragraphs.en: Higher-scoring behavior: Claude Opus 5 on smart_turnover_split_rev . A higher-Sharpe candidate was rejected after a control showed that its gain came from an independent reversal exposure. The zero-sum constraint requires the within-window weights to sum to zero, removing the ordinary window-average return from the constructed signal.
paragraphs.zh: 得分更高的行为：Claude Opus 5 在 smart_turnover_split_rev 上的表现。 一个夏普比率更高的候选方案被拒绝了，因为一项对照实验表明其收益来自一次独立的反转暴露。 零和约束要求窗口内的权重之和为零，从而从构建的信号中移除了普通的窗口平均回报。

sents.en: Higher-scoring behavior: Claude Opus 5 on smart_turnover_split_rev .
sents.zh: 得分更高的行为：Claude Opus 5 在 smart_turnover_split_rev 上的表现。

sents.en: A higher-Sharpe candidate was rejected after a control showed that its gain came from an independent reversal exposure.
sents.zh: 一个夏普比率更高的候选方案被拒绝了，因为一项对照实验表明其收益来自一次独立的反转暴露。

sents.en: The zero-sum constraint requires the within-window weights to sum to zero, removing the ordinary window-average return from the constructed signal.
sents.zh: 零和约束要求窗口内的权重之和为零，从而从构建的信号中移除了普通的窗口平均回报。

paragraphs.en: Iterations 9–10. The high-participation-only candidate reaches Sharpe 3.866, above the incumbent’s 3.361. Removing the zero-sum constraint, however, introduces the negative window-average return, which is an ordinary intraday-reversal factor. The pure-reversal control has Sharpe 2.754, and the high-participation-only candidate’s loading on it rises from 0.467 to 0.636. The additional performance therefore comes from a different signal source rather than a better implementation of participation-conditioned return. Deliver the lower-scoring zero-sum incumbent.
paragraphs.zh: 迭代 9–10。 仅高参与度候选人的夏普指数达到 3.866，高于现任者的 3.361。 然而，移除零和约束后，出现了负窗口平均回报率，这是一种普通的日内反转因子。 纯反转对照组的夏普指数为 2.754，而仅高参与度候选人在该对照组上的载荷从 0.467 上升至 0.636。 因此，额外的收益来自不同的信号源，而非对参与条件化回报率的更优实现。 提供得分较低的零和现任者。

sents.en: Iterations 9–10.
The high-participation-only candidate reaches Sharpe 3.866, above the incumbent’s 3.361.
sents.zh: 仅高参与度候选人的夏普指数达到 3.866，高于现任者的 3.361。

sents.en: Removing the zero-sum constraint, however, introduces the negative window-average return, which is an ordinary intraday-reversal factor.
sents.zh: 然而，移除零和约束后，出现了负窗口平均回报率，这是一种普通的日内反转因子。

sents.en: The pure-reversal control has Sharpe 2.754, and the high-participation-only candidate’s loading on it rises from 0.467 to 0.636.
sents.zh: 纯反转对照组的夏普指数为 2.754，而仅高参与度候选人在该对照组上的载荷从 0.467 上升至 0.636。

sents.en: The additional performance therefore comes from a different signal source rather than a better implementation of participation-conditioned return.
sents.zh: 因此，额外的收益来自不同的信号源，而非对参与条件化回报率的更优实现。

sents.en: Deliver the lower-scoring zero-sum incumbent.
sents.zh: 提供得分较低的零和现任者。

paragraphs.en: Here final selection preserves the intended mechanism even when the alternative passes the financial threshold by a wider margin.
paragraphs.zh: 在此，最终选择保留了预期的机制，即使替代方案以更大幅度的优势通过了财务门槛。

paragraphs.en: Lower-scoring behavior: MiniMax-M3 on order_mix_surprise_amp . The selected candidate appends a generic reversal component after the report-grounded order-mix signal plateaus. Here, K K is the historical lookback in trading days, and reversal-40 is a separate 40-day return-reversal signal.
paragraphs.zh: 得分较低的行为：order_mix_surprise_amp 上的 MiniMax-M3。 在基于报告的订单混合信号趋于平稳后，所选候选体会附加一个通用的反转组件。 此处，K K 是交易日的历史回溯期，而 reversal-40 是一个独立的 40 天收益反转信号。

sents.en: Lower-scoring behavior: MiniMax-M3 on order_mix_surprise_amp .
sents.zh: 得分较低的行为：order_mix_surprise_amp 上的 MiniMax-M3。

sents.en: The selected candidate appends a generic reversal component after the report-grounded order-mix signal plateaus.
sents.zh: 在基于报告的订单混合信号趋于平稳后，所选候选体会附加一个通用的反转组件。

sents.en: Here, K K is the historical lookback in trading days, and reversal-40 is a separate 40-day return-reversal signal.
sents.zh: 此处，K K 是交易日的历史回溯期，而 reversal-40 是一个独立的 40 天收益反转信号。

paragraphs.en: Iterations 8–9. The pure K = 90 K=90 order-mix signal has Sharpe 0.184. Adding a 30% 40-day reversal component raises Sharpe to 0.855 and produces perfect monotonicity. This is the best candidate in the current run.
paragraphs.zh: 迭代 8–9。 纯 K = 90 K=90 的订单混合信号的夏普指数为 0.184。 加入一个 30% 的 40 天反转成分后，夏普指数升至 0.855，并实现了完美的单调性。 这是当前运行中的最佳候选方案。

sents.en: Iterations 8–9.
The pure K = 90 K=90 order-mix signal has Sharpe 0.184.
sents.zh: 纯 K = 90 K=90 的订单混合信号的夏普指数为 0.184。

sents.en: Adding a 30% 40-day reversal component raises Sharpe to 0.855 and produces perfect monotonicity.
sents.zh: 加入一个 30% 的 40 天反转成分后，夏普指数升至 0.855，并实现了完美的单调性。

sents.en: This is the best candidate in the current run.
sents.zh: 这是当前运行中的最佳候选方案。

paragraphs.en: Final selection. Deliver the blended version. The construction retains the order-mix surprise and amplitude weighting, with a 30% reversal-40 component added for complementarity.
paragraphs.zh: 最终选择。 交付融合后的版本。 该结构保留了顺序混合的惊喜感和振幅加权，并额外加入了 30% 的反转-40 成分以实现互补性。

sents.en: Final selection.
sents.zh: 最终选择。

sents.en: Deliver the blended version.
sents.zh: 交付融合后的版本。

sents.en: The construction retains the order-mix surprise and amplitude weighting, with a 30% reversal-40 component added for complementarity.
sents.zh: 该结构保留了顺序混合的惊喜感和振幅加权，并额外加入了 30% 的反转-40 成分以实现互补性。

paragraphs.en: The selection follows the improved backtest even though the added component supplies an independent return-reversal signal. This is the type of metric-driven extension that the alignment audit is designed to distinguish from refinement of the assigned hypothesis.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管新增组件提供了独立的回报反转信号，但选择过程仍遵循改进后的回测方法。 这正是此类指标驱动型的扩展，而一致性审计正是为了将其与既定假设的优化区分开来而设计的。
